intention: Give analytics a monthly derived-metrics table and the job that fills it. The job pools each vehicle's valid charge records (USER manual entries and DONE supercharger sessions only, RD2), drops small-delta rows, and stores the median as effective_capacity_kwh keyed on (tesla_id, effective_period). Two new ports: MonthlyMetricsCalculator writes, PackCapacityReader reads with a newest-earlier fallback. PackCapacityReader satisfies charging.PackCapacityReader structurally, so tier 3 can drop the hardcoded 62.0 without a Go import cycle.

decisions.decision: Rejected the worker's first D7, which added PackCapacityKWh to the existing analytics.Reader interface. Required two NEW interfaces instead, with analytics.Reader untouched, and a NewPackCapacityReader constructor.
decisions.why: go vet compiles _test.go, so widening Reader breaks the fakes at app/processor_test.go:275 and gateway/handlers_test.go:219,:1162. Tier 1 cannot touch them and gateway has no RM52 tier.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's own rule for an even sample count: average the two middle values. Recorded in design.md and pinned by a test fixture.
decisions.why: RD3 chose the median but never pinned even counts. An unstated rule would be settled later by whatever the code happened to do.
